title: Anna's Party
text:
Anna has a birthday party on Saturday. She writes an invitation for her friend Tom. Tom is happy to get the invitation.

The party is at Anna's house at two o'clock. Tom brings a small present. They play games, eat cake and dance together.

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel about the invitation?
What kind of friend is Tom?
options: A friend who is kind and shares fun
A friend who does not like games
A friend who lives far away

vocabulary.definition: an event where friends meet to eat, drink and have fun
a card or message that asks someone to come to an event
a thing that you give to someone on a special day
activities that people play for fun

paragraph_translations: Anna ma przyjęcie urodzinowe w sobotę. Pisze zaproszenie dla swojego przyjaciela Toma. Tom cieszy się, że dostał zaproszenie.
Przyjęcie odbywa się w domu Anny o godzinie drugiej. Tom przynosi mały prezent. Grają w gry, jedzą tort i tańczą razem.
